DEAL OR NO DEAL AI - EDUCATIONAL SOURCE
AUTHORING DRAFT - FICTIONAL - NOT AN EXECUTED AGREEMENT

Equipment term-loan summary | E-N01 | Version 1
Prepared: 2026-10-22 | Proposed transaction date: 2026-10-23
Borrower and legal entity: Example Equipment LLC
Lender: Demo Learning Bank (fictional)
Facility: One USD term loan; reference E-N01-FACILITY

Requested and proposed funded amount: USD 1200000
Documented term: 48 months
Documented maturity date: 2030-10-23
Fixed annual interest rate: 6%; no index, spread or reset applies.
Repayment: Principal and interest per the supplied annual forecast schedule.
Full-term amortization, balloon and refinancing adequacy are not assessed.

Use of proceeds: USD 900000 equipment purchase and USD 300000 repayment
of existing funded debt. These allocations are fictional case assumptions.
Security: First-ranking charge over the equipment pool in COLLATERAL-1.
Guarantees: None. This is an explicit fictional term, not missing information.
Covenants: Supply annual financial statements. No automatic covenant
compliance conclusion is made by the educational application.

The financial schedules concern this borrower and this one facility only.
They are case-author supplied projections, not forecasts generated by AI.
The prepared date is not proof that a real loan exists or has been approved.

DEAL OR NO DEAL AI - EDUCATIONAL SOURCE
AUTHORING DRAFT - FICTIONAL - NOT AUDITED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS

Example Equipment LLC | E-N01-FACILITY | FINANCIALS-1 v1 | Page 1 of 2
Prepared: 2026-10-22. USD whole units; not thousands or millions.
Standalone borrower scope; no parent, guarantor or unrelated facility.
2026 and 2027 columns below are supplied annual projections, not actuals.
Calendar years: 01 January through 31 December of each named year.

ANNUAL PROJECTION                     2026              2027
Revenue                            4000000           4400000
Net income                         Not supplied       700000
Interest expense                   Not supplied       100000
Income-tax expense                 Not supplied       100000
Depreciation                       Not supplied       100000
Amortization                       Not supplied       100000

Cash available for debt service, annual principal and interest, and the
required scope qualification continue on FINANCIALS-1 page 2.
Neither revenue nor EBITDA substitutes for documented cash available.

DEAL OR NO DEAL AI - EDUCATIONAL SOURCE
AUTHORING DRAFT - FICTIONAL - SUPPLIED SCHEDULE, NOT AN AI FORECAST

Example Equipment LLC | E-N01-FACILITY | FINANCIALS-1 v1 | Page 2 of 2
USD whole units. Annual projection: 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31.
Standalone borrower; transaction basis TXN-1, pro forma at 2026-10-23.

SUPPLIED ANNUAL DEBT-SERVICE AND CASH SCHEDULE
Cash available for debt service:                900000
Annual principal payments:                     500000
Annual interest payments:                      100000
Qualification: Both payment lines include the proposed E-N01 loan and
remaining borrower funded debt after the documented repayment.
These are supplied annual totals, not a validated full-term loan schedule.

DOCUMENTED TRANSACTION AND BALANCE-SHEET BASIS TXN-1
Existing funded debt immediately before transaction:       2400000
Proposed funded borrowing in this transaction:              1200000
Existing funded debt repaid in this transaction:             300000
Current assets, same pro-forma date:                        1500000
Current liabilities, same pro-forma date:                    750000

The repaid 300000 is already part of existing funded debt and is deducted
once only. Do not subtract it a second time or assume a net-cash deduction.
Existing remaining debt has no prior-ranking lien on COLLATERAL-1's pool
under this fictional scenario. See COLLATERAL-1 page 1 for explicit liens.
FINANCIALS-1 page 1 supplies annual income-statement components and units.

DEAL OR NO DEAL AI - EDUCATIONAL SOURCE
AUTHORING DRAFT - FICTIONAL - NOT A REAL APPRAISAL OR LIEN SEARCH

Example Equipment LLC | E-N01-FACILITY | COLLATERAL-1 v1 | Page 1 of 2
Prepared: 2026-10-22. Valuation basis: proposed transaction 2026-10-23.
Currency: USD whole units. Equipment collateral only; no real estate.

Eligible equipment pool value:                         2000000
Proposed facility exposure secured by this pool:        1200000
Documented prior-ranking liens on this pool:                  0

The 2000000 combines existing and proposed eligible equipment under this
fictional case's stated basis; do not treat it as new-purchase cost alone.
The explicit zero is an authored scenario fact, not a default for missing
lien data. No haircut, lien search, valuation verification or legal opinion
has been performed. These statements require review before case registration.

Scope: The same Example Equipment LLC and E-N01-FACILITY as the loan and
financial schedules. Values are synthetic inputs for FIN-1.0 only.

DEAL OR NO DEAL AI - EDUCATIONAL SOURCE
AUTHORING DRAFT - FICTIONAL - CASE-AUTHOR ASSESSMENTS, NOT BANK RATINGS

Example Equipment LLC | E-N01-FACILITY | COLLATERAL-1 v1 | Page 2 of 2
Assessment as of: 2026-10-23. Subject: standalone borrower only.
All premises and ratings below await human case-author review.

Fictional credit-history premise: scheduled payments are current with no
recorded arrears within the scenario. No bureau or external check was run.
Fictional business premise: an equipment-using manufacturer with ordinary
cyclical demand exposure. No market research or concentration test was run.

PROPOSED EDUCATIONAL FACTOR ASSESSMENTS - HIGHER MEANS MORE RISK
Repayment capacity: 20/100. Basis: supplied annual CFADS and debt service.
Financial leverage: 25/100. Basis: documented debt and EBITDA components.
Collateral quality: 20/100. Basis: supplied equipment value/exposure/liens.
Borrower credit profile: 15/100. Basis: the fictional history premise above.
Business and industry risk: 30/100. Basis: the fictional business premise above.

These are individually authored illustrative ratings, not generated by a
DSCR, LTV, leverage or credit-score conversion rule. No predictive model,
probability of default or real underwriting recommendation is represented.
Missing or unsupported material inputs invalidate the affected assessment;
the presence of a proposed rating never cures missing evidence.
